ext.description: Replicate IntelliJ IDEA's Git UI and workflow in VSCode
cmd.compareFileWithBranch: Compare This File with Another Branch
cmd.initRepository: Initialize a Git Repository in This Folder
cmd.amendCommit: Amend Last Commit (Fold Current Changes In)
cmd.createTag: Create Tag on Commit (Lightweight or Annotated)
cmd.createWorktree: Check Out a Branch in a New Worktree
config.cacheEnabled: Enable branch info caching for faster startup (cache is persisted and only updated on repository changes or Git operations)
config.pullStrategy: Update strategy when pulling a remote branch
config.language: Display language of the extension UI
config.debug: Enable debug logging (written to the extension host console for troubleshooting)
config.autoFetchMinutes: Fetch from the remote every N minutes while the GitCharm panel is open. 0 (the default) disables it. Silent: no credential prompt, no error toast.
config.protectedBranches: Branch name patterns that ask for confirmation before a force-push or deletion. `*` matches any run of characters (e.g. `release/*`). The operation is never blocked outright.
